preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**4 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer N where 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N for N, B in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly N space-separated integers B₁, B₂, ..., Bₙ.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= (i + 1) for i, B in enumerate([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()], 1))
preconditions.description: For each Bᵢ in the sequence, 1 ≤ Bᵢ ≤ i (1-based index).
The input has exactly T test cases, each with 2 lines (N and B sequence).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == 'YES') == (all(B[i] == B[j] or math.gcd(B[i], B[j]) == B[i] == B[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i + 1, N)) and all(B[i] == B[j] or math.gcd(B[i], B[j]) == B[i] or math.gcd(B[i], B[j]) == B[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i + 1, N)) and all(B[i] == i or any(B[i] == math.gcd(B[k], B[l]) for k in range(1, N + 1) for l in range(k + 1, N + 1) if B[k] != B[l]) for i in range(1, N + 1))) for N, B, stdout_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]) if N == len(B))
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if and only if the sequence B can be obtained from the initial sequence A (where Aᵢ = i) by performing any number of operations where each operation replaces two elements Aᵢ and Aⱼ with their GCD. This holds if and only if: (1) For every pair of elements in B, their GCD is equal to one of the elements in the pair (i.e., the GCD closure property holds), and (2) Every element in B is either equal to its original index or can be derived as the GCD of some pair of other elements in B.
